notes.title: Finally set to be released in the first half of 2025 on multiple platforms!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/93f21238f97cf269142178b4da52e9a136c2d350.png[/img]
Thank you for waiting so long! The complete edition will be released on Nintendo Switch,Xbox Siries X,PS4 and PS5 in the first half of 2025! The publisher is KEMCO, a Japanese company!
[list]
[*] A prequel story about Ars and Memento
[*]  New event illustrations
[/list]
These will be added to the Steam version for free as an update, available at the same time as the Switch release.
I believe this game has been nurtured by our Steam users, and I would be grateful if you could accept our heartfelt thanks!
However, due to some issues with a Chinese company, the contract was terminated, so the Chinese language will not be available in the  Nintendo Switch,Xbox Siries X,PS4 and PS5 version. Since I want many players from Chinese-speaking regions to enjoy the game, I hope to work something out through further discussions.

tags.feature: A prequel story about Ars and Memento

notes.title: Now it's easy to play over and over again!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/2d8505ee96b847dbd3472efbf3e4ec962800b35d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628395/641f0c2d964935bdf28d62543941dc489532b989.png[/img][/url]
This time, based on user feedback!
[list]
[*] Skip Skip to the next action part immediately
[*] Auto Fast Forward
[*]The updated version will be listed on the title screen
[/list]
We have made a major change to the
Now you can jump directly from the scenario selection to the action screen, making it easier to play repeatedly!

As for the side stories, we've made it easier to see that they are separate from the main story
[list]
[*]  Change the color.
[*]  The main story will have a leading line
[/list]
The following bugs have also been fixed
[list]
[*] Once you press Backlog, it disappears from the menu screen

[/list]
Thanks to your kind feedback, this game is now much easier to play!
Please continue to support this game and Furoshiki Laboratory

notes.title: Launch! Future updates planned
notes.content:
The game's finally out in English, Chinese, and Japanese!
Thank you to all the players who supported us

Much of this game is experimental and we are looking for player impressions and feedback.
Please let us know what you think in the reviews and community.

We'll be updating this game frequently to make it even more perfect. Here are the current plans

[list]
[*] More event stills will be added
[*] Bug fixes
[*] Fixes to the UI to make it easier to play
[/list]
